svg.data-weight-note: 6.4 kg (14.1 lb) in the guide's Table 12; 14.9 lb (6.8 kg) in the datasheet
svg.data-throughput: 480 Gbps full duplex, non-blocking on all ports (datasheet)
svg.data-sfp-plus-speeds: 10 GbE or 1 GbE on each SFP+ port (datasheet)
svg.data-power-current-max: 2.75 A at 100 VAC; 1.15 A at 240 VAC
svg.data-redundancy-note: two internal 275 W supplies in 1+1, load sharing at about half load each
svg.data-cooling: six internal fans, not customer replaceable; front-to-back in the -FB and back-to-front in the -BF
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to +40 C, +35 C maximum with a fan or supply failed
svg.data-humidity: 10 to 90 percent noncondensing operating, 10 to 95 percent storage
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: SFP+ 10GBASE-SR and 10GBASE-LR transceivers and 1 m and 3 m direct access cables
svg.data-console: one RS-232 serial console port, a mini-USB connector with an external cable to D9
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Class A, EN 55022 Class A, VCCI Class A, ICES-003, AS/NZS CISPR 22 Class A
